title: Resolve the pinned Maven BOMs from the retained local mirror
description: The first two S48 runs stopped before Maven at Gradle BOM resolution despite the exact published POM being in both machine caches. Give Gradle an offline, release-only file repository for retained BOMs, run the original fixed Maven WAR plugin and record the selected payload and entry order in both archives.

steps.name: Resolve original BOMs locally and execute the Maven goal
